decisions.reason: As a large, R&D-active German marking-systems firm, it would usually keep a newly launched printer close to its core portfolio absent clear evidence of performance below aspiration, especially given complementary service and installed-base advantages.

This software module strongly fits the firm's digitalization and traceability path, uses existing capabilities and customer relationships, and is likely to be tolerated even with uncertain early sales because the resource burden is relatively low.

The coder for non-absorbent surfaces extends the established offer into an important application area, so with no reported shortfall and with organizational slack the firm would more likely continue learning and selling than withdraw it quickly.
